ms.report:
Hello. 
Change of Scope (Increase)
After technical commencement of the project, it was discovered that the changes due to the multiple Hardforks to the CSL library were so invasive that the original Swift.Cardano library could not be upgraded. Over 90% of the code (due to the complex architecture of this low-level library was throw away. 
As such, the library has been rebuilt from ground up. As per below, we have renamed, published and branded a new library called "CardanoKit. This library still utilises Emurgo's Cardano Multiplatform serialization library (RUST), however the scope of technical work increased dramatically.
This has been the major reason for the delay in progressing through this project. However, we are now well into the final phases, and will update the subsequent milestones accordingly. 
Hard Forked Repository (Now a new not a hard forked repository)
A new CardanoKit library has been created here.
Integration of CSL
The CardanoKit and its Tokeo developed dependency, CSL Kit, expose the latest stable version of Emurgo's Cardano Serialisation Library v14.1.2. This includes an updated FFI, and C/Swift Cardano translation layer, and application layer abstraction via CardanoKit library.
Implementation Plan
See build plan here​
Published Test Summary Report. (Tests now cover a subset of tests of the new library, rather than extensive tests across the original)
See test summary report and example app here. https://github.com/TokeoPay/CardanoKit in the repo there is an example directory showing the example app and test files. 
A test plan has also been summarised on our Git Docs here: https://gitbook.tokeo.io/tokeo/technical-information/cardanokit/catalyst-fund-12
100% Test pass. 
Key tests:
・Parse bech32 cardano address string
・Convert address to Hex
・Convert address back to bech32

Marketing
Promotional marketing on this project via X Post has been done here https://x.com/Tokeo_io/status/1936082787481567343​

Initial Submission
Code merged via GitHub: https://github.com/TokeoPay/CardanoKit
Successful Unit Tests (100%): Test Summary Report (https://tokeo.gitbook.io/tokeo/tokeo/technical-information/cardanokit/catalyst-fund-12#milestone-4-complete) + Github tests

Test summary video published : https://tokeo.io/blog/cardanokit-milestone-4-beta-release-with-application-ready-features/ and https://x.com/Tokeo_io/status/1962709249798349186
Response to Rejection Feedback
There was a specific test case that covered delegation to "Always Obstain" in order to claim rewards. 
This test is called: "test_signing_a_drep_and_stake_withdrawal_txn". (https://github.com/TokeoPay/CardanoKit/blob/main/Tests/CardanoKitTests/CardanoWalletTesting.swift)
 This in effect shows the transaction building capabilities and parsing capabilities with respect to DPREP primitives have been built, and tested. 
I appreciate that there could be more explicit test cases delivered around the DREP functionality however it was intended that the final suite of tests, along with the demo-application being made public (also demostrating all DREP / tx functionality) will be delivered with Milestone 5. These are currently being worked on. Further, in light of being a full rebuild i would kindly ask that this position is considered acceptable. 
Irrespective, the full suite of tests is being worked on and a code commit over the coming day or two will have these included. Appreciate your time in the review.
